description: Source code for socket management functions in uWebSockets, including socket operations such as close, shutdown, write, and address retrieval, with conditional SSL support.

methods.name: us_socket_local_port
methods.description: Returns the local port number of the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_remote_port
methods.description: Returns the remote port number of the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_shutdown_read
methods.description: Shuts down reading on the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_remote_address
methods.description: Retrieves the remote IP address of the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_timeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_long_timeout
methods.description: Sets a long timeout for the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_is_closed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: us_socket_is_established
methods.description: Checks if the socket connection is established.

methods.name: us_socket_close_connecting
methods.description: Closes a connecting socket without emitting on_close.

methods.name: us_socket_close
methods.description: Closes the socket and emits on_close event.

methods.name: us_socket_get_native_handle
methods.description: Returns the native handle of the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_write2
methods.description: Writes header and payload data to the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_ext
methods.description: Returns extension data associated with the socket.

methods.name: us_socket_is_shut_down
methods.description: Checks if the socket is shut down.
